capabilities: embed .mscz and .mscx scores in notes via code blocks
play embedded scores with note highlighting and page following
edit scores in a full OTS_WebEditor notation editor tab
save edited score copies to the vault with local draft recovery
open score files in the MuseScore desktop application
disambiguation: Not a grading or scoring tool; it handles music notation scores (.mscz/.mscx files).
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.7.2+); the ~40 MB bundle exceeds Obsidian Sync's per-file limit, so it must be installed separately per device. Licensed GPL-3.0-only; no telemetry or accounts; marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: MuseScorer is an Obsidian adaptation of OTS_WebEditor by OurTextScores
problem: Obsidian cannot render, play or edit MuseScore notation files, so musicians must leave the vault to view or work on scores.
